advisory.suggested_fix:
In _content function around line 135-140, conditionally construct provenance based on whether issue_key is non-empty:

```python
if narrative.issue_key:
    provenance = (f"Opened by the agentic development platform for {narrative.issue_key}, "
                  f"execution {narrative.execution_id}.")
else:
    provenance = f"Opened by the agentic development platform, execution {narrative.execution_id}."
```
